messages:
Liam: hi team first week here — trying to reproduce a bug that only shows when a prod feature flag is toggled. I don't need permanent admin but need to flip one flag briefly. who should I ask?
Sofia: welcome Liam! short answer: request a temporary admin session via the access requests page. infra approves time-bound roles.
Liam: I clicked Request access in Console but it says "Org admins only". where's the form?
Sofia: use https://redwood.internal/access-requests -> select "temporary-admin", include ticket id and desired expiry (max 8h). approver flow requires justification + rollback plan.
Nina: fwiw if it's only a flag change we suggest creating a short-lived service account scoped to flags and prod-read/write. infra still needs to issue it.
Liam: can you show a quick curl example for toggling a flag via the Console API?
Nina: sure — example (replace ${SA_TOKEN} with the token infra gives or a temp session token):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/flags/research_experiment/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SA_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"on","target":"prod","note":"debug repro - expire 2026-03-24T18:00Z"}'
```
Sofia: reminder: prod flag changes require an approver with 2FA and a linked ticket. include a monitoring screenshot and a rollback criterion in the request.
Liam: ok i'm opening ticket ENG-4021 now and will request a 4h window. tagging infra: @infra
infra: received ENG-4021. please attach the repro steps and confirm whether IP allowlist is required. if not, we'll issue temp creds via the SSO-approved flow.
Liam: repro attached in the ticket. no IP allowlist needed. thanks.
access-bot: Temporary access request #4021-TEMP-ADMIN created by Liam. Expires: 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z. Status: pending approver :hourglass:
Sofia: once approved, go to Console > My tokens > Temporary session to mint a short-lived token. please remember to either revert the flag manually or set an automated rollback after the test window.
Liam: awesome, thanks everyone! super helpful. excited to be here :wave:
